baseline_reproduction.interpretation: Exact reproduction of frozen legacy human platform evidence; this is separate from SAFE AI study evidence.

eligibility.age_bins: Same18-24,25-34,35-44,45-54,55+ as frozen H-wave metrics; benchmark observedages18-99 differ from main adultHON18-79
eligibility.label_status: Inherited frozen H-wave manifest, not freshly joined canonical label status; manifest numeric fields verified only

limitations: All H-wave benchmark selection and old duplicate-audit coverage limits remain.
Matching supplied samples and targetvariance supports commonbenchmark metadata; full1000 frozen prediction vectors were not independently paired.
Age/gender baseline predicts rating variation associated with recorded context; differences from visual models do not identify causal appearance effects.
Algorithms and tuning differ across benchmark waves; this is a diagnostic comparison, not a controlled input ablation.
No images, embeddings, pickle files, tensors or model caches loaded; no remote file writes.

protocol.missingness: No imputation needed: all frozen manifest ages, genders and beauty scores valid
protocol.model: separate natural cubic age OLS in each recorded-gender group, equivalent to full age-basis by gender interaction
protocol.outcome: received supplied beauty score0-10, not an independent criterion of attractiveness or contribution
protocol.r2: 1-SSE/SST relative to test-target mean, not squared Spearman
protocol.status: exploratory supplement; specified after inspecting H-wave progression
protocol.test: 1000fixed test profiles; one prediction per profile; no repeated-image weighting
protocol.training: 8000 fixed train profiles, equal profile weights, original beauty_score target; fit means/scales and coefficients on train only
protocol.uncertainty: Point metrics only; full matching frozen H-wave prediction vectors absent, so no paired CI or significance claim
protocol.validation: 1000fixed validation profiles diagnostic only, no tuning or model selection

experiments.audit_scope: Metric/config snapshot only. Full-account global duplicate-component artifacts unavailable at inspected paths; no new model training or account-level predictions exported.

interpretation.configurations: H1-H7 pixels at prediction time (H7 auxiliary age/gender training targets);H8 visual plus pre-UV landmarks;H9+ demographic/geographic/portfolio context and ensembles. Later models cannot be described as pixel-only.
interpretation.delta_mismatch: H11-H20 code reconstructs phase-I reference vectors; stored paired deltas that differ from subtraction of frozen metric files are flagged and their inference suppressed. Full matching frozen prediction vectors were not supplied in per-wave artifacts; sample predictions cannot repair this.
interpretation.duplicate_scope: Source dataset.py unions non-sampled bridge accounts in older766174-image audit plus selected image hashes; new3685764-image global audit components not available in finalization paths. Source-level grouping is supported, full-new-audit split safety is unverified.
interpretation.exploratory: Repeatedly inspected experiment progression and sequential choices; no untouched confirmatory final test
interpretation.r2: Use saved profile_test.r2 for target beauty-score predictive skill, not percentile-rank variance
interpretation.rank: Spearman is rank association; never substitute1-rho^2 for residual variance or predictive R2
interpretation.target: supplied beauty score, source0-10 scale, benchmark10000 profiles not fullHON

archived_models.specification: Archived exp_rates.e13: OLS log ECV on -age; free 1/2/3-breakpoint continuous models on 0.05-Myr grid; stasis_step fixes slopes in phases I and III to zero; published_phases fixes boundaries at 2.0,1.5,0.7 Ma. Parameter penalties retain original code. No event-aligned fits or new causal tests.

fossil_environment.bin_definition: floor(age_ma / 0.1), identical binary floating-point operation to archived exp_rates.e13; empty bins retained as null

climate_source.age_model: Published LR04 graphic correlation and orbitally tuned age model with sedimentation-rate constraints; no retuning or resampling
climate_source.signal: Benthic oxygen isotope stack: global ice volume and deep-ocean temperature, not direct air temperature
climate_source.version: Author-hosted LR04 stack, updated August 1, 2005: removed age rounding at 3.0-1.5 Ma; added 0.64 cib. correction

events.date_meaning: approximate conventional transition boundaries, not a confidence interval
events.interpretation_limit: Longer and stronger glacial cycles developed across a transition; these boundaries do not date a single catastrophe.
events.label: Middle Pleistocene Transition

events.date_meaning: climate interval on the study age model, not a confidence interval
events.geography: North Atlantic and southwest European proxy records
events.interpretation_limit: European hominin depopulation is a demographic inference from proxy, habitat-model and occupation evidence; not a measured global extinction or ancestral bottleneck.
events.label: MIS 34 cooling

events.date_meaning: stadial duration on the study age model, not dating error
events.evidence_status: extreme terminal cooling in proxy records
events.interpretation_limit: Nested within MIS34; the regional demographic inference remains distinct from the environmental observation.
events.label: MIS 34 terminal stadial

events.date_meaning: model-inferred demographic duration, not a confidence interval
events.effective_size_meaning: genetic-model effective population size, not a census of surviving humans
events.geography: Proposed ancestral population of modern humans
events.interpretation_limit: FitCoal inference is contested by statistical-artifact and insufficient-fit critiques. The 2026 methodological defense does not establish consensus. Muttoni and Kent's 2024 MIS22 migration/timing interpretation is distinct from MIS34 cooling near 1.1 Ma.
events.label: Ancestral bottleneck (disputed)

events.date_meaning: rounded event age; reported analytical age errors below are separate from event duration

dating_source_audit.page_note: SI Table S1 p2 labels plateau ages plus/minus 2 sigma. SI tektite-dating discussion explicitly calls 788.9+/-2.4 ka 2 sigma. The article main text calls the prior date a five-tektite mean; the SI says nine. We retain the date without asserting a reconciled prior specimen count.

events.evidence_status: established impact evidence; source-location interpretation contested
events.geography: Australasian tektite field; proposed Bolaven source in Laos
events.interpretation_limit: Tektite evidence establishes an impact. Bolaven source arguments and biological consequences require separate assessment; no verified evidence here establishes a cause of cranial-volume stasis.
events.label: Australasian impact
